visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with light brown hair tied back, wearing a light blue pleated blouse with a circular brooch, sits at a wooden table. She uses a gold metallic marker to draw intricate patterns on a white seashell. Her facial expression is calm and focused, with gentle hand movements as she rotates the shell. The background features high-end jewelry display cases with warm spotlighting and elegant white floral arrangements. (2) The scene transitions to a younger woman with long dark hair wearing a black fuzzy sweater, sitting by a large window with soft natural daylight. She is also seen from the head and shoulders, using a gold marker to decorate a white seashell on a workspace. The atmosphere is peaceful and bright. (3) Returning to the first woman, she is intercut between talking directly to the camera and holding a glass of dark red beverage with a cinnamon stick. She displays her finished seashell artwork, which includes a red Christmas tree and blue star motifs. Her expressions shift from focused drawing to warm smiles and conversational gestures. (4) The two women appear together in a selfie-perspective shot, both smiling and holding their decorated seashells and glasses. The video concludes with high-detail close-ups of a dessert plate featuring a gift-box-shaped cake, macarons, and the final decorated seashell, set against a soft-focus background of indoor holiday decorations.
